    Interlacement classes and Roiter clinging #

    Package the source-faithful global interface in BGRS, Section 8.3. A contour function clings at a source when every pair of related paths admits representatives in the same respective interlacement classes on which the contour value is one. If clinging at every source detects the identity and a local exact correction adds one source while preserving previous ones, finite source induction gives contour-cohomology vanishing.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.PathInterlacementRelation {Q : Type v} [Quiver Q] (R : PathContourRelation Q) :
    Type (max v w)

    An equivalence relation on parallel paths representing the interlacement classes inside every nonzero ray. Compatibility with a particular ray-category realization is intentionally kept separate.

    • interlaced {i j : Q} : Quiver.Path i j → Quiver.Path i j → Prop
    • refl' {i j : Q} (p : Quiver.Path i j) : self.interlaced p p
    • symm' {i j : Q} {p q : Quiver.Path i j} : self.interlaced p q → self.interlaced q p
    • trans' {i j : Q} {p q r : Quiver.Path i j} : self.interlaced p q → self.interlaced q r → self.interlaced p r

        def LargeIndecomposable.ContourFunctionClingsToPath {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : Type v} [Quiver Q] (R : PathContourRelation Q) (I : PathInterlacementRelation R) (c : ↥(contourScalarFunctionSubgroup R)) {x y : Q} (p : Quiver.Path x y) :
        Prop

        A contour function clings to the nonzero ray selected by one path when every other representative admits same-class replacements on which the contour value is one. This is the path-level form of membership in the set M(c) in BGRS 8.6.

                  def LargeIndecomposable.HasRoiterClingingPathStep {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : Type v} [Quiver Q] (R : PathContourRelation Q) (I : PathInterlacementRelation R) :
